name: VBMR Griffon
armament: Remote weapon station with 7.62 mm MG, 12.7 mm M2HB or 40 mm grenade launcher
protection: Ballistic and mine protection, acoustic gunshot detector and soft-kill sensors. Game: immune to small-calibre rounds; 7.62x54R AP and larger can penetrate side/rear and disable wheels/engine; every launcher in the game list penetrates.
visual_notes: Very tall 6x6 with a high V-shaped hull and big windscreen-like front glass on driver/commander
Front axle well forward, two rear axles close together
Remote weapon station on roof with Antares sensor block
Rear door with steps; side doors absent, many roof hatches
